roles/discoveryengine.admin.title: Discovery Engine Admin
roles/discoveryengine.admin.desc: Grants full access to all discoveryengine resources.

roles/discoveryengine.agentspaceAdmin.title: Gemini Enterprise Admin
roles/discoveryengine.agentspaceAdmin.desc: Grants admin-level access to Gemini Enterprise resources.

roles/discoveryengine.agentspaceRestrict.title: Gemini Enterprise Restricted User
roles/discoveryengine.agentspaceRestrict.desc: Grants restricted user-level access to Gemini Enterprise resources, for fine-grained control over multiple Gemini Enterprise instances in the same project. Principals with this role will need to be granted an unrestricted user-level role (e.g. /agentspaceUser) on an Engine policy in order to use Gemini Enterprise.

roles/discoveryengine.agentspaceUser.title: Gemini Enterprise User
roles/discoveryengine.agentspaceUser.desc: Grants user-level access to Gemini Enterprise resources.

roles/discoveryengine.agentspaceViewer.title: Gemini Enterprise Viewer
roles/discoveryengine.agentspaceViewer.desc: Grants access to view the details of Gemini Enterprise resources.

roles/discoveryengine.editor.title: Discovery Engine Editor
roles/discoveryengine.editor.desc: Grants read and write access to all discovery engine resources.

roles/discoveryengine.notebookEditor.title: Cloud NotebookLM Notebook Editor
roles/discoveryengine.notebookEditor.desc: Grants read and write access to a Cloud NotebookLM Notebook.

roles/discoveryengine.notebookLmOwner.title: Cloud NotebookLM Admin
roles/discoveryengine.notebookLmOwner.desc: Grants full access to Cloud NotebookLM resources.

roles/discoveryengine.notebookLmUser.title: Cloud NotebookLM User
roles/discoveryengine.notebookLmUser.desc: Grants user-level access to Cloud NotebookLM resources.

roles/discoveryengine.notebookOwner.title: Cloud NotebookLM Notebook Owner
roles/discoveryengine.notebookOwner.desc: Grants full access to a Cloud NotebookLM Notebook.

roles/discoveryengine.notebookViewer.title: Cloud NotebookLM Notebook Viewer
roles/discoveryengine.notebookViewer.desc: Grants read-only access to a Cloud NotebookLM Notebook.

roles/discoveryengine.serviceAgent.title: Discovery Engine Service Agent
roles/discoveryengine.serviceAgent.desc: Discovery Engine service uploads documents and user events from Cloud Storage and BigQuery, reports results to the customer Cloud Storage bucket, writes logs to customer projects using Cloud Logging, and writes and reads metrics for customer using Cloud Monitoring.

roles/discoveryengine.user.title: Discovery Engine User
roles/discoveryengine.user.desc: Grants user-level access to Discovery Engine resources.

roles/discoveryengine.viewer.title: Discovery Engine Viewer
roles/discoveryengine.viewer.desc: Grants read access to all discovery engine resources.
